judged_text: symmetricDecrypt and JSON.parse run unguarded, so a payload encrypted with a mismatched/rotated key (decipher.final throws 'bad decrypt') or one that decrypts to non-JSON (SyntaxError) surfaces as an unhandled 500. After any key mismatch between the parent and this deployment, every sync delivery 500s with no actionable response and the parent retries a payload that can never succeed; a valid-secret-but-garbage payload gets a 5xx where a 4xx belongs.

adjudication.rationale: In the newly added webhook handler `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the code directly does `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || ""))` with no try/catch or validation around decryption/parsing. If the encryption key is mismatched/rotated or the ciphertext is invalid, `symmetricDecrypt` can throw; if the plaintext is not valid JSON, `JSON.parse` will throw. Either exception will bubble up and produce an unhandled 500 from the API route rather than a controlled 4xx with an actionable error, matching the finding.
